statements.statement: The denial reason code is CO-197
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The dizziness and giddiness are clinically consistent with hemodynamic instability secondary to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment
The service was ordered to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic episodes and underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic changes
Prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior authorization for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring services
